$comment: Researcher seat permission profile ({{FORT_NAME}}). Loaded only by fort/scripts/researcher.sh with --setting-sources '' so ambient user and project settings cannot widen it. The LAUNCHER'S exact tool set is the security boundary: it withholds Bash and Task/Agent entirely, along with every write tool. These denies are defense in depth only; command denies bind spellings rather than capabilities. In particular, the Bash .env* denies remain as a belt-and-suspenders control should a future launcher change mistakenly add Bash.
